follow-up time: Variable, up to 12 years after pregnancy
cohort: 14 female patients diagnosed with PA after experiencing hypertension during pregnancy
finding: The study found that PA is associated with a high rate of pregnancy-related complications, particularly preeclampsia and preterm delivery, highlighting the importance of early PA diagnosis and management to improve pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Ten subjects delivered by Caesarean section (in 3 cases due to early-onset preeclampsia and 2 subjects due to significantly increased blood pressure), and 9 cases spontaneously (1 subject complicated twice due to late-onset preeclampsia).
gest_age: Preterm delivery occurred in 5 cases - the earliest one in the sixth month of gestation.
